First, note the starting date: 1064-09-19 (assuming YYYY-MM-DD).  
40 weeks = 40 × 7 = 280 days.  
Add 4 more days → total 284 days.  

1064 is a leap year (divisible by 4 and not by 100 in Gregorian rules).  
From 1064-09-19:  
Remaining days in September: 11 (19th to 30th inclusive = 12 days? Let's check: 19th → 30th is 12 days, but we count from the next day if adding days: actually, adding 284 days means day 0 = Sept 19, day 1 = Sept 20, so remaining days in Sept after 19th = 11 days (Sept 20–30).  

So:  
284 days total  
Subtract 11 days → 273 left, year advances to 1065.  
1065 is not leap (divisible by 4 but 1065? Wait, 1065 ÷ 4 = 266.25, not divisible, so not leap).  

Days in months 1065:  
Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31, Aug 31, Sep 30, Oct 31, Nov 30, Dec 31.  

Subtract from 273:  
Jan 31 → 242 left  
Feb 28 → 214 left  
Mar 31 → 183 left  
Apr 30 → 153 left  
May 31 → 122 left  
Jun 30 → 92 left  
Jul 31 → 61 left  
Aug 31 → 30 left  
Sep 30 → 0 left exactly.  

So 30 days into September 1065: September has 30 days, so 30th day = September 30.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1065-09-30
